name: Nomura Mutsumi
source:
A Japanese teacher at Reiki Girls' Academy, and the homeroom teacher of Haruka and Mizuki, 25 years old.

A year ago, she broke off her engagement and hasn't had a boyfriend since.
She was originally supposed to be the dorm supervisor this year, so she is suspicious of the last-minute personnel changes that saw her replaced by Oizumi.
Because of the broken engagement, she has become distrustful of men, and is cold towards Kengo.

[Translated from the [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20121105072348/http://slpr.sakura.ne.jp/DEEP2/]official site,archived[/url]]
